messages.author: f24b6672b86b41b4
messages.subject: workflowr 1.2.0
parts:
Hi all,

I've submitted workflowr 1.2.0 to CRAN. It will take some time before the binaries are built and the mirrors are updated. To start using right away, you can install from GitHub:

devtools::install_github("jdblischak/workflowr")

The biggest changes include:
  • GitLab is now officially supported
  • The reproducibility report and session information chunks are collapsed
  • Improved support for caching
  • Vignette on sharing code across analyses
  • Vignette on deploying workflowr websites
Another important update for existing workflowr projects is that links to past versions of the HTML files are now served via raw.githack. The previous service, rawgit, is being shutdown. If you have any trouble with viewing past HTML files, re-publishing with workflowr 1.2.0 should fix the problem. To update all links to past versions of the HTML files, you can republish all your files:

wflow_publish(republish = TRUE)

See the release notes for more details.

Best,

John
